bossJelly.prompt: A colossal bioluminescent jellyfish queen of the deep sea: a tall translucent glowing bell dome in rose pink and soft violet, crowned on top with an ornate crown of pink coral branches, white pearls and gold filigree; a radiant glowing pearl heart inside the bell; thick, sculptural flowing ribbon tentacles and frilly oral arms in cyan and magenta hanging below, gathered close to the body.

bossFishNight.prompt: A colossal deep-sea anglerfish king of the night: massive body of dark indigo and midnight-blue armored scales with gold trim, a crown of tall glowing cyan crystal spines along its back, a huge glowing star-like lantern lure on a curved stalk above its head, wide royal fins like a tattered violet cloak, a gold-armored jaw with crystal fangs, glowing cyan eyes.

bossFish.prompt: A colossal ancient spiny fish king of a haunted kelp forest: a huge armored lionfish-pufferfish with jade-green and emerald scales, long venomous fan spines with gold tips spreading like a royal crown and cloak, moss and glowing kelp growing on its back, an ancient stone-like armored jaw, glowing emerald eyes.

bossKelpSerpent.prompt: A colossal sea serpent king coiled upright: emerald-green scales with gold edges, a flowing mane of glowing seaweed and kelp, curved golden horns and a crown of coral, a glowing jade-white underbelly, fierce dragon-like head with glowing eyes, thick compact coils.

bossLava.prompt: A colossal magma jellyfish king: a tall bell dome of cracked glossy black obsidian with bright glowing molten orange and yellow veins, crowned with jagged glowing volcanic crystals and gold, a blazing molten heart inside, thick sculptural tentacles of glowing liquid fire and ember chains hanging below, vivid orange, gold and crimson.

bossFlame.prompt: A towering fire god of the lava abyss: a muscular upper body armored in cracked molten rock with glowing lava seams and gold ornaments, a blazing crown of flame-shaped obsidian spikes and two great curved horns, burning eyes, one hand holding a glowing fire orb, the lower body becoming a thick swirling column of solid stylized flame, a few fire orbs orbiting close.

bossApep.prompt: Apophis, a colossal Egyptian cobra god of chaos rearing up high: a wide spread hood decorated with gold and lapis lazuli Egyptian patterns and a glowing red eye of chaos in its center, deep purple-black scales, golden scarab armor plates along its body, glowing ruby eyes, a golden uraeus crown, thick coils on the sand-colored base of its body.

bossMummy.prompt: A towering undead pharaoh king floating above the ground: body wrapped in ancient glowing linen bandages, a golden nemes headdress with blue lapis stripes and a golden death mask face with glowing cyan eyes, a broad golden collar and golden armor, holding a golden crook and flail, a long tattered royal cloak, golden scarab ornaments.

bossTitan.prompt: A colossal marble titan guardian of Olympus: a powerful humanoid body of polished white marble with glowing golden cracks and veins, golden greek armor and a laurel crown, a radiant golden halo behind the head, a blue cloth cape, holding a huge broken greek column as a club.

bossHydra.prompt: The Hydra of Lerna: a colossal serpent monster with three fierce dragon heads on long thick necks rising from one body, green-gold scales, bronze greek armor plates on the chest, golden horns on every head, glowing poison-green eyes and mouths, a thick compact coiled tail.
